about_the_game:
This DLC includes INK's Original Soundtrack music and high resolution INK Wallpapers.
The music was composed by Vincent Rubinetti. The songs will be included in high quality MP3 and OGG formats.
The art was made by Fellipe Martins. All Wallpapers are 1920x1080 resolution in JPEG format.

Songs will be located in your INK folder in the Steam Directory:
...\Steam\steamapps\common\INK\OST

Wallpapers will be located in your INK folder in the Steam Directory:
...\Steam\steamapps\common\INK\Wallpapers
